desktop_required: Run the desktop app to start real downloads.
empty_body: Add a link. Flux handles the connections, recovery, and verification.
add_description: Add a file, media source, collection or torrent to your local queue.
language_description: Choose the language that feels like home.
privacy: Local storage. Your files stay yours.
powered: Powered by Rust · Built for the open web
interceptExplanation: Browser transfer pauses immediately and is removed when Flux accepts it.
nativeInstallHelp: If the extension cannot connect, open Settings → Browser integration → Repair browser bridge.
mediaHint: Play a video to detect its media requests.
remove_description: Remove this task and its temporary data? The completed file is kept.
segment_urls: TS segment URLs (one per line, optional)
estimated_time: Older record: estimated from the file modification time.
subtitles_discovery_hint: Inspect the source to discover available subtitles.
normalize_audio_hint: Two-pass EBU R128 normalization to −23 LUFS.
lossless_audio_hint: Copies the original audio without re-encoding.
power_hint: Runs once after the queue succeeds. A 30-second countdown allows cancellation.
nativeConsentExplain: Send selected download URLs, page titles and required cookies or authorization headers to Flux on this computer. Flux uses them only to download the selected file; no analytics are sent. You can withdraw this permission here.
mediaReady: Choose the video quality and output format, then send it to Flux.
collection_hint: Select up to 500 videos. Quality is resolved when each transfer starts.
torrent_source_hint: Paste a magnet link or torrent URL, or choose a local .torrent file.
torrent_limits_hint: Verified files follow the selected seeding rule.
torrent_min_limit: Torrent limits must be 0 or at least {{count}} B/s.
host_accounts_help: Keys are encrypted on this device. Supported host links resolve through enabled accounts.
updates_help: Updates are verified with the Flux signing key before installation.
update_description: Your download checkpoints will be saved before installation.
bridge_automatic: Flux automatically registers and repairs its local browser bridge at startup, including the portable edition.
bridge_extension_step: Install and enable the Flux extension in your browser, allow its requested site/native messaging permissions, then refresh existing tabs. Host registration does not install the extension.
bridge_repair_help: If the extension cannot connect, open Settings → Browser integration → Repair browser bridge.
bridge_dismiss: Got it — do not show again
watch_help: Watch selected folders for .torrent files. Files are checked every 3 seconds after they stop changing. Identical files are imported once, including across restarts. Subfolders are excluded. Save to apply.
watch_automatic: Add to the download queue automatically
rpm_updates_help: Linux RPM updates are installed through your package manager. Open the latest release, download the RPM, and install it with dnf.
filename_prefix_hint: Use / for subfolders. Your last 10 prefixes are saved.
filename_prefix_invalid: Invalid prefix. Use relative subfolders and a valid filename, with no .. or absolute paths.
bridge_connection_help: Open your browser and the Flux extension popup to connect. Install and enable the extension from GitHub if needed.
bridge_not_found: No connected Flux extension was found. It may be missing, disabled, awaiting permission, or the browser may be closed. Download the extension from GitHub, enable it, then open its popup.
extension_update_help: A connected extension needs an update. Download the new ZIP from GitHub, replace the old extension and reconnect. Latest version:
size_source_hint: Some sources do not report a size before download.
torrent_magnet_selection: For magnets, select files in task details after metadata is retrieved.
preview_not_ready: Not enough readable video data yet. Try again later.
preview_download_hint: A frame from downloaded data. Availability depends on the video format.
portable_updates_help: Portable updates open the download page. Close Flux and replace the App files; keep the Data folder.
